title: KaizerSpawn
description: A simplistic spawn plugin for 1.21.X servers
body:
The best light weight spawn plugin
Usage
- /spawn teleports you to spawn
- /setspawn sets the spawn teleport location
- /ks rejointp true/false used if you want to tp back to spawn after you rejoin 
- /ks reload
The plugin is configutable in config.yml
Have fun and like the plugin pls it would mean a lot ot me <3
